review.evidence: The complete native token-level role event census is resolved and both active minters remain inventoried. Exact non-proxy token source has no code-upgrade entrypoint, but owner can add arbitrary minters without delay; immutable token bytecode is not collateral-gated issuance. One minter has verified signed-order and NAV-rate logic; the original minter's current enforcement and the custom owner's signature policy remain unverified. Accountable publishes gross reserves versus token supply, not net NAV after borrowed USDT. Sibling USDu retains periodic reconciliation and attestation-only supervision on its Accountable dashboard and HT Digital report series. The retrieved 25 September 2026 HT Digital letter expressly covers USDu Solana mint 9ckR7pPPvyPadACDTzLwK2ZAEeUJ3qGSnzPs8bVaHrSy and assets held for USDu; it does not name either XGLD deployment or reconcile XGLD's borrowed-USDT liabilities. The backing/custody overview likewise scopes its monthly reports to USDu/sUSDu. No equivalent XGLD-specific HT Digital/administrator reconciliation was retrieved, so XGLD retains unknown reconciliation/supervision and unbounded-reconciliation-unknown posture rather than importing a different token's assurance. Program EVM audit listings are contextual, not proof that these exact XGLD deployments were audited. Base OFT controls belong to Bridge Risk.
